info.title: CMU Courses web API
info.description: Same-origin API for cmu.courses. JSON field names are camelCase. Writes need an `Origin` header equal to the site's origin. Errors are `{ code, message }`.

delete.summary: Deletes all of the caller's data and signs out all of their sessions.

401.description: The document is for signed-in CMU users only

get.summary: Search courses, optionally limited to a term, department, level or unit count.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words to search for in codes, titles and descriptions, or a course number such as `15-122`, `15122` or `15-1`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only courses offered in this term.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department name, such as `Computer Science`, or a two-digit prefix, such as `15`.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Course level in hundreds, such as `100` for 15-122 or `400` for 15-445.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Courses that can be taken for this many units.

get.summary: One course, by code (`15-122`) or id (`15122`), with its offerings, and its sections when `term` is given.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Include this term's sections and meetings.

get.summary: The caller's imported final exams for a term, earliest first.

parameters.name: courses
parameters.description: Only these courses: comma-separated ids or codes.

post.summary:
Replaces the term's import with the final exams in an SIO calendar: one multipart field `calendar`, a UTF-8
`.ics` file of at most 120 KiB. Events that aren't finals for this term's courses are dropped, and a calendar with
none keeps the previous import.

delete.summary: Removes the caller's import for a term.

get.summary: Accepted friends and pending requests either way.

post.summary: Asks someone, by Andrew ID, to be friends. They must have signed in once.

get.summary: Accepted friends taking each course in `term`: course id to friends' names.

post.summary: Creates a single-use invite link valid for seven days, replacing the caller's previous one.

get.summary: Who made an invite, so the invite page can say who it's from. Seeing it doesn't use the invite up.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the caller's invites.

post.summary: Accepts an invite: the two become friends at once and the link is used up.

get.summary: What the caller shows accepted friends.

put.summary: Changes what the caller shows accepted friends. Accepting a friendship never changes this.

delete.summary: Declines, cancels or ends a friendship. Either person can, and access ends at once.

post.summary: Accepts an incoming request. Only its recipient can.

get.summary: An accepted friend's schedules marked visible to friends; empty unless they share schedules.
200 when the catalog opens with this build's schema and the user database takes writes.
The signed-in CMU user.

403.description: Signed in without a verified CMU email

get.summary: The caller's plans, oldest first.

409.description: A plan with this id exists

put.summary: Replaces a plan. A stale `revision` gets 409 with the current plan.

get.summary: The caller's preferences.

put.summary: Replaces the preferences. A stale `revision` gets 409 with the current preferences.

get.summary: The caller's academic record.

put.summary: Replaces the academic record. A stale `revision` gets 409 with the current record.

get.summary: The caller's saved courses, oldest first.

put.summary: Saves a course. Saving it again changes nothing.

delete.summary: Un-saves a course. Removing one that isn't saved changes nothing.

get.summary: The caller's schedules, oldest first.

400.description: Invalid, or not in the catalog

409.description: A schedule with this id exists

put.summary: Replaces a schedule. A stale `revision` gets 409 with the current schedule.

429.description: Over the daily write cap or the per-minute limit

delete.summary: Deletes a schedule and its share link.

post.summary: Creates a read-only share link, or returns the existing one.

get.summary: A schedule shared by link. Anyone with the link may read it; it never names its owner.

A past syllabus file, for signed-in CMU users. PDFs are shown inline (`?download=1` downloads them); other types
are attachments. Saved as `<term>-<file>`.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: `1` downloads a PDF instead of showing it.

get.summary: Every term, newest first.

Starts sign-in. With Keycloak, the login layer has already completed the OIDC flow by the time this runs, so it
only redirects to `returnTo`.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: A path on this site to return to afterwards. Defaults to `/`.

parameters.name: as
parameters.description: Development sign-in only: the Andrew ID to act as.

CalendarDisplay.description: What calendar blocks show besides the course code.

title.description: The course's name (or a topics section's title), when the block is tall enough. Off unless chosen.

sections.description: The sections in `term`, when `term` was given.

id.description: The friendship's id, used by the other friend routes.

sharesCourses.description: An accepted friend shows you the courses they're taking.

sharesSchedules.description: An accepted friend shows you their schedules marked visible to friends.

url.description: The website's page that redeems it.

InviteInfo.description: Who made an invite, for the invite page before the invite is accepted.

name.description: The name of the student who made the invite.

days.description: Weekdays, 0 for Monday through 6 for Sunday; empty when TBA.

start.description: Minutes after midnight, Pittsburgh time; null when TBA.

id.description: An id of your own, as for schedules. Defaults to a new UUID.

An id of your own (1 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`), so a retried create can't make two. Defaults to a
new UUID.

Onboarding.description: The first-run prompt to add the academic record.

asked.description: The student added their record or skipped the prompt.

promptHidden.description: The "add your record" nudges were closed.

id.description: Unique within the plan, so a repeatable course can appear twice.

units.description: Units to count for a variable-unit course.

oneOf.description: While set, the term's courses come from this schedule.

Preferences.description: Preferences that follow the student between devices.

activeSchedule.description: Term id to the schedule shown for it.

revision.description: 0 when nothing has been saved yet.
The revision this change is based on; 0 to create.

ProgramSelection.description: Which program version a plan audits against (`lib/plan-types.ts`).

auditId.description: The audit version (entry year and campus).

overrides.description: Course id to its requisite waivers.

revision.description: 0 when nothing has been saved yet.

courseId.description: Five-digit course id; null for transfer credit with no CMU equivalent.

revision.description: The revision this change is based on; 0 to create.

createdAt.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, set by the server.

revision.description: Increments on every write. Send it back with the next write.

shareId.description: The read-only share token, when a share link exists.

child.description: The chosen child section (recitation or lab) of `section`, or null.

color.description: Index into the course color palette.

hidden.description: Left off the calendar and the unit total.

section.description: The chosen top-level section (a lecture or a standalone section), or null before one is picked.

revision.description: The revision this change is based on.

parent.description: The lecture this section belongs to, if any.

SectionPicker.description: How the schedule page picks a course's sections: dropdowns of every option, or compact buttons to hover through.

url.description: The website's page for the link.

SharedSchedule.description: What a share link shows: no owner, id or visibility.

shareCourses.description: Accepted friends see the courses you're taking, from your record and friends-visible schedules.

shareSchedules.description: Accepted friends see your schedules marked visible to friends.

StoredOverride.description: A requisite waiver for one course.
